analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($1.47) vs SMA5/20/50 ($1.26/$1.08/$1.09) — short-term and mid-term uptrend confirmed above
· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($1.15/$1.27) — mid-to-long-term trend strength maintained
· 52-week position (21.9%) + current price level is high relative to historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (86.1→86.1) + sustained overbought condition + upward momentum maintained
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.0530→0.0530) + holding steady diagnosis + bullish trend continuation signal
· Bollinger Band current price position (Upper $1.36) + approaching upper band, band width at 51.52% indicating expanding volatility
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($1.38) + basis (above 5-day low, Pivot S1 at $1.13)
· Swing resistance ($1.49) + potential for further upside on breakout
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (5-day high renewal continues) + strengthening uptrend
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (2.43x vs 5-day average) + increased confidence in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis (uptrend) + enter on breakout above $1.49 resistance, wait-and-see on break below $1.38 support
